        if (!this.track) return;

        this.isDragging = false;
        this.startX = 0;
        this.translateX = 0;
        this.autoScrollSpeed = 0.8;
        this.animationId = null;
        this.itemGap = 20;

        var dataEl = this.querySelector('.media-logos-data-' + sid);
        this.itemsData = dataEl ? JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent) : [];

        this.cloneItems();
        this.setupDrag();
        this.startAutoScroll();
      }

      disconnectedCallback() {
        if (this.animationId) {
          cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);

      }

      renderItems() {
        this.track.innerHTML = '';
        var self = this;
        this.itemsData.forEach(function(item, index) {

          itemEl.className = 'media-logos-item-' + sid;

          if (item.logo) {

          if (item.quote) {

            quoteDiv.className = 'media-logos-quote-' + sid;

            var quoteText = document.createElement('div');
            quoteText.className = 'media-logos-quote-text-' + sid;
            quoteText.textContent = item.quote;
            quoteDiv.appendChild(quoteText);
            itemEl.appendChild(quoteDiv);
          }

          self.track.appendChild(itemEl);
        });

        this.items = Array.from(this.track.querySelectorAll('.media-logos-item-' + sid));
      }

      cloneItems() {
        var self = this;
        var itemsToClone = this.items.slice();
        itemsToClone.forEach(function(item) {
          var clone = item.cloneNode(true);
          self.track.appendChild(clone);

        this.allItems = Array.from(this.track.querySelectorAll('.media-logos-item-' + sid));

        document.addEventListener('touchend', this.handleDragEnd.bind(this));

<script>
  (function() {
    var lightbox = document.getElementById('video-lightbox');
    var iframeWrap = lightbox.querySelector('.video-lightbox__iframe-wrap');
    var closeBtn = lightbox.querySelector('.video-lightbox__close');

    function getYouTubeId(url) {
      var match = url.match(/(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=|youtu\.be\/|youtube\.com\/embed\/)([^&?#]+)/);
      return match ? match[1] : null;
    }

    function getVimeoId(url) {
      var match = url.match(/vimeo\.com\/(\d+)/);
      return match ? match[1] : null;
    }

    function openLightbox(videoUrl) {
      var ytId = getYouTubeId(videoUrl);
      var vimeoId = getVimeoId(videoUrl);
      var embedUrl = '';

      if (ytId) {
        embedUrl = 'https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + ytId + '?autoplay=1&rel=0';
      } else if (vimeoId) {
        embedUrl = 'https://player.vimeo.com/video/' + vimeoId + '?autoplay=1';
      }

      if (!embedUrl) return;

      iframeWrap.innerHTML = '<iframe src="' + embedUrl + '" allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; fullscreen" allowfullscreen></iframe>';
      lightbox.classList.add('is-open');
      lightbox.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
      document.body.classList.add('video-lightbox-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeLightbox() {
      lightbox.classList.remove('is-open');
      lightbox.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      document.body.classList.remove('video-lightbox-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
      iframeWrap.innerHTML = '';
    }

    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);

    // Click on background (not the wrapper) to close
    lightbox.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === lightbox) {
        closeLightbox();
      }
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && lightbox.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        closeLightbox();
      }
    });

    // Intercept clicks on YouTube/Vimeo links
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var link = e.target.closest('a[href*="youtube.com/watch"], a[href*="youtu.be/"], a[href*="vimeo.com/"]');
      if (link) {
        e.preventDefault();
        openLightbox(link.href);
      }
    });
  })();
</script>
